summary_paragraph: A woman with end-stage renal disease on hemodialysis was admitted for elective placement of a left arm AV loop graft. Due to vessel calcification, a PTFE graft was placed successfully. She was monitored overnight for hand ischemia and neuropathy symptoms, which remained stable. She received hemodialysis via her existing tunneled catheter and was discharged home the following day with instructions to monitor graft function, avoid venipuncture or blood pressure measurements in the left arm, and follow up with the access clinic. No complications were observed during the admission.
